title: What is missing?
communication_goal: El estudiante puede decir qué no hay y explicar qué falta en un espacio.
situation: Preparar una sala y avisar que faltan objetos necesarios.

context.before: A team prepares a meeting room and reports missing items.

dialogue.speaker: Assistant
dialogue.text: No, there aren't enough chairs. There are no clean cups, either.

dialogue.speaker: Organizer
dialogue.text: Okay. We need two more chairs and some cups.

explanation_es: There isn't se usa con singular: There isn't a printer. There aren't se usa con plural: There aren't enough chairs. También puedes usar There is no + singular o There are no + plural para decir que no hay.
spanish_speaker_notes: No digas There isn't chairs; chairs es plural y necesita There aren't.
Enough significa suficiente y va antes del sustantivo plural: enough chairs.
Para solucionar el problema añade una acción: We need more chairs.

pronunciation.target: Producir negativas con there isn't y there aren't y destacar el objeto que falta.
pronunciation.student_feedback: La negación debe ser audible porque cambia el significado del reporte.

reading.title: The room is almost ready
reading.text: The meeting room has tables and a projector. There isn't a printer. There aren't enough chairs for everyone. There are no clean cups. The team writes a list of missing items and asks for help.

options: Writes a list and asks for help
questions.answer: Writes a list and asks for help

activities.instruction: Clasifica el problema como singular o plural.
activities.feedback_correct: La cantidad determina isn't o aren't.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Printer/coffee son no contables o singulares aquí; chairs/cups son plurales.

activities.feedback_correct: Entendiste el objeto y la cantidad insuficiente.
Printer es singular: There isn't a printer.
Chairs es plural: There aren't enough chairs.
La forma plural es there aren't.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Chairs es plural; cambia isn't por aren't.

activities.instruction: Graba un reporte de dos problemas y una solución.
activities.prompt: There isn't a printer. There aren't enough chairs. We need more chairs.
activities.feedback_correct: Reportaste problemas y propusiste una acción.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Marca isn't/aren't y después enfatiza la solución need more chairs.

activities.instruction: Lee el reporte y completa la lista de cosas que faltan.
activities.feedback_correct: Identificaste los problemas y la acción del equipo.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Busca printer, chairs y clean cups.

activities.instruction: La IA es la persona responsable. Reporta qué falta en una sala y propone qué necesitan.
activities.student_goal: Use negative there is/are and state two needs.
activities.feedback_correct: Describiste un problema y ayudaste a resolverlo.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Singular: There isn't...; plural: There aren't...; solución: We need...

activities.instruction: Envía un reporte de tres cosas que faltan en una casa, sala o trabajo.
activities.prompt: There isn't ____. There aren't ____. We need ____.
activities.feedback_correct: Usaste la estructura para resolver una necesidad concreta.
activities.feedback_incorrect: Separa un problema singular, uno plural y la solución.
Singular = isn't; plural = aren't; para solucionar usa We need.

mastery_criteria.retry_policy: Los errores se programan para recuperación a 1, 3, 7 y 14 días.
